problem.title_html: Your screens are ruining your posture. Slowly, but surely.
problem.text_html:
It starts with “just one more class,” “one last email,” “one more episode.” Eight hours later, your shoulders have dropped, your head is forward, and your back is taking the hit in silence.

What you’re feeling — fatigue, tension, back pain — is your body begging for a posture that no one ever taught you. The worst part? You get used to it. Until the day it becomes the norm.
problem.tip_html: Every centimeter your head moves forward adds up to 4 kg of pressure on your cervical spine. Your back carries it for you. Every single day.

comparison.title: Why choose the Smart Posture Corrector?

social_proof.title: They straightened up.
social_proof.rev1_meta: Using the Smart Posture Corrector for 3 months
social_proof.rev1_text: In 3 weeks, my neck pain almost completely disappeared. I can't live without it.
social_proof.rev2_text: The vibration is so subtle you forget about it... until you realize you're standing straighter!
social_proof.rev3_text: I recommend it to all my clients. Visible results in less than a month.
social_proof.rev4_meta: Physiotherapist, working with the device for a year
social_proof.rev4_text: I now offer it to all my patients who suffer from back pain. It really changes their daily comfort.
social_proof.rev5_text: After long study sessions at my desk I used to wake up with a stiff neck. Not anymore since I started wearing it.
social_proof.rev6_text: The discreet vibration reminds me to sit up without ever interrupting my flow. Genuinely life-changing for me.
social_proof.rev7_text: I run after it all day and my shoulders finally thank me. Light, comfortable and really effective.
social_proof.rev8_meta: Designer, stands a lot to draw
social_proof.rev8_text: I had almost given up on posture tools. This one is the first I forget I am wearing, and it actually works.
social_proof.rev9_text: Subtle as it is, the reminder arrives exactly when I need it. I have recommended it to my whole team.
social_proof.rev10_text: A genuinely well-designed concept. I present it to my patients alongside their exercises, the results follow.
social_proof.rev11_text: My back pain has noticeably decreased in a month. I would not go back to a day without it.
social_proof.rev12_text: I carry heavy gear all day, this little device keeps my posture aligned and my energy up.
social_proof.rev13_text: Standing at the board for hours was exhausting. Now the reminder keeps me straight without me thinking about it.
social_proof.rev14_meta: Office worker, 8 years sitting at a desk
social_proof.rev14_text: The quality is impressive and the follow-up app is very clear. My posture improved within two weeks.
social_proof.rev15_text: A more balanced posture rubs off on my riding. A surprising but very welcome bonus.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1_question: How does the Smart Posture Corrector work?
faq.q1_answer: It uses a 6-axis gyroscope that detects micro-slouches of your spine in real time. It emits a gentle vibration as soon as you slouch past your ideal posture threshold.
faq.q2_answer: No, it is only 8mm thick and slips discreetly under your t-shirt or shirt. It is completely invisible.
faq.q3_question: How long does it take to see results?
faq.q3_answer: Most of our users report visible improvements after 2 to 3 weeks of regular use (at least 30 mins/day).
faq.q4_answer: The battery lasts up to 7 days under normal use. A full charge takes about 1 hour and 30 minutes via USB-C.
faq.q5_answer: Yes, the Smart Posture Corrector comes with a 2-year warranty.

how_it_works.title: How it works
how_it_works.subtitle: A 3-step approach to actively retrain your posture every day.
how_it_works.step1_text: Place the sensor on your back. It automatically calibrates your ideal posture in real time.
how_it_works.step2_text: As soon as you slouch, a gentle vibration reminds you to straighten up without any pain.
how_it_works.step3_text: Day after day, you build the muscle memory needed to stand up straight without thinking about it.
